Read the whole filename before any deploy. This one points `source` at the generated `.deploy/amazon-functions` artifact, but emulators:exec does NOT run predeploy hooks, so the lane must invoke apps/amazon/functions/scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs itself first. It declares no rules and no indexes, so a stray `firebase deploy` here can push only the functions codebase — never rules; agents never run `firebase deploy` at all (root CLAUDE.md, Critical rules). The tasks port is pinned rather than left to auto-assign: firebase-tools' controller.ts reads `listenForEmulator.eventarc` in the tasks slot on the late-port-assignment path, so an explicit port avoids that. PORT INVENTORY across every emulator config in this repo, so a new one picks free numbers rather than colliding with a lane that only fails when both run at once: firebase.functions.json 8080/5001, firebase.rules.json 8081, firebase.mercado-livre.json 8082, firebase.mercado-livre.tasks.json 8083/5002/9499, firebase.e2e.json 9099/8080/9199/5001 (auth/firestore/storage/functions, the same numbers as firebase.functions.json — the two never run together), firebase.shopee.tasks.json 8084/5003/9500, firebase.loja-integrada.tasks.json 8085/5004/9501, 8086 reserved for Shopee's step-22 `firebase.shopee.json` (firestore only), and THIS file 8087/5005/9502.
